note: Only invariants and bundle size are gated. Absolute timings are NOT gated: the v1.3 workload is a different, larger real application (a 10,000-row route in a full multi-route app) than the v1.2 synthetic scenarios, so cross-version timing deltas would be meaningless. See methodology.md.

bundleDisclosure.note: The shipped artifact (minified full barrel gzip) is unchanged at 20105 B. The diagnostic unminified-source gzip moved +1 B (28764->28765) — byte-level source noise, disclosed, not hidden. No shipped-size regression.

gates.detail: toggling 1 of N controls writes a constant number of regions regardless of N (fine-grained property)
typing one field does not mutate an unrelated field (DOM-level proof)
repeated mount/unmount cycles create an identical node count each cycle
all router transitions render the correct route
shipped minified full-barrel gzip 20105 must be <= 20105 (unchanged); diagnostic unminified full-barrel gzip 28765 vs v1.2 28764 (delta +1 B / 0.0035%, within 0.1% disclosed tolerance)
